scope: Proposition 8.2 (The comparison development) of the manuscript “Quantitative Near-Kerr Evolution and Generic C2 Future Inextendibility” (preprints/Quantitative-Near-Kerr-Evolution-and-Generic-C2-Future-Inextendibility-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 264 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cd38cc55e3c203a3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 86. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a single sufficiently small p10 neighbor- hood such that, for each datum d in it, the preceding exterior and interior solutions assemble with the finite bridge evolution into a smooth time-oriented vacuum development Pd with the complete bridge Σ as a Cauchy surface. It contains an entire spacelike cylinder S ≃ R × S2 carrying the entry data of Section 7, followed by its full product double-null wedge. There is a time-orientation-preserving open isometric embedding Pd ˓→ Md into the full MGHD of d.
